title: Paper vs GraalVM Paper vs PEX
subtitle: 26.3 · 8 bots each · 4 CPU cores each
notes: All servers ran at once on one Pelican node, each limited to 4 CPU cores and 8 GB of RAM, with view and simulation distance 10. Replace the placeholder IDs with your Pelican server UUIDs (they are also the Docker container names).
Every server started from its own copy of world/base-world-262.tgz.
Bots (8 per server: 3 builders, 2 miners, 2 AFK, 1 explorer) played 20–60 minute sessions with 5–15 minute breaks on a seeded schedule, identical for every server.
